summary: Verified Expo SDK 54→57 upgrade + vector-icons migration end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed (test_riforma_2027.py) — /api/content 200 without 'fasi', /api/assistant 200 with Italian text. Frontend web preview: Metro bundled (1326 modules) without red screen. Ionicons font successfully loaded from CDN (document.fonts shows {family:'Ionicons', status:'loaded'}), 15 elements on home / 22 on tracker use Ionicons font-family — icons render (no tofu). All 7 acceptance flows pass: (1) Home shows TutelApp wordmark, 'Come funziona · Riforma 2027' banner, region card Liguria, IL PERCORSO card, home-start-btn, home-tracker-link. (2) Wizard /valutazione: 3 steps completable via opt-who/opt-when/opt-cert + wizard-next-btn → navigates to /risultati/{id}. (3) Results renders next-steps-section with cert-explainer-card, law104-card, invalidity-card. (5) /riforma header 'Come funziona' + icons, /faq + icons, /importi + icons, /contatti + icons, /patronati + icons, /territorio + icons all load without errors. Only non-blocking React Native Web deprecation warnings observed (shadow*/textShadow*), already tracked in iteration_8.
